records.source: Don't you have work to do?$a
records.translation: 你不是還有工作要做嗎？$a

records.source: I wonder how much the new baby will change things?$s
records.translation: 不知道新寶寶會讓生活改變多少？$s

records.source: {0}, I hope our adoption request gets approved. I want a baby.$l
records.translation: {0}，希望我們的收養申請能獲得批准。我想要一個寶寶。$l

records.source: {0}, I filed our adoption papers. Now all we can do is cross our fingers and wait.$l
records.translation: {0}，我已經遞交收養文件了。現在我們只能祈禱並等待。$l

records.source: Ugh... I feel a little nauseated this morning.$s
records.translation: 呃……我今天早上有點噁心。$s

records.source: I'm pregnant... can't you make your own breakfast?$s
records.translation: 我懷孕了……你不能自己做早餐嗎？$s

records.source: {0}, we're going to have a baby soon.$l
I just feel like sleeping today. Don't worry about it.$a
records.translation: 我今天只想睡覺。別擔心。$a

records.source: {0}, we're going to have a baby soon.$l
Being a parent is annoying, sometimes...  I just don't feel like getting up.$a
records.translation: 當父母有時真讓人心煩……我就是不想起床。$a

records.source: I need some alone time... Why don't you take care of the kids for a change?$a
records.translation: 我需要獨處一下……這次換你來照顧孩子怎麼樣？$a

records.source: I was going to make you breakfast, but I changed my mind.$a
records.translation: 我本來想替你做早餐，但我改變主意了。$a

records.source: I got up early and watered some crops for you. I hope it makes your job a little easier today.
records.translation: 我一早起床，替你澆了一些作物。希望能讓你今天輕鬆一點。

records.source: #$e#I also filled the pets' water bowls.
records.translation: #$e#我也替寵物們的水碗加滿了水。

records.source: I got up early to water some crops and they were already done! You've really got this place under control.$h
records.translation: 我一早起床想替作物澆水，結果早就澆好了！你真的把這裡打理得井井有條。$h

records.source: I got up early and fed all the farm animals. I hope that makes your job a little easier today.
records.translation: 我一早起床，餵了所有農場動物。希望能讓你今天輕鬆一點。

records.source: I spent the morning repairing a few of the fences. They should be as good as new.
records.translation: 我整個早上修了幾段圍欄。現在應該跟新的一樣。

records.source: I ordered this the other day and it just arrived.
records.translation: 這是我前幾天訂的，剛剛送到。

records.source: I figured the room could use a little more decoration.
records.translation: 我覺得這個房間可以再多一點裝飾。

records.source: I was going to do some decorating today, but I changed my mind.$a
records.translation: 我本來想今天裝飾一下，但我改變主意了。$a

records.source: What do you think of the new wallpaper I chose?
records.translation: 你覺得我選的新壁紙怎麼樣？

records.source: What do you think of the new flooring I chose?
records.translation: 你覺得我選的新地板怎麼樣？

records.source: *sigh*... sometimes I miss my old life.$s
records.translation: *嘆氣*……有時我會懷念以前的生活。$s

records.source: The weather's too gloomy to get out of bed.$s
records.translation: 天氣陰沉得讓人不想起床。$s
